change_log.summary: Allow multiple HydrationSession records (append-only history) and define deterministic selection; add scan-time monotonic anchors to enforce trusted time/reboot lockout and offline staleness window; align dependency floors (ERR-1>=1.4.11, PAY-3>=2.8.1).

change_log.note: Physics-aware hardening: hydrate_manifest bulkhead routing (DP-1), dependency floor alignment, and explicit materialization requirement for RedemptionStatus.

change_log.summary: Structural Sovereignty: added events.emits + outbox_events, producer binding, DATA-1 attribute labeling, and PII/crypto leak bans. Enables EVT-1 Mechanical Parity registration.

Phase 5 hardening: remove envelope keys from outbox payload keys, normalize schema_ref to 'EVT-2', raise EVT-1 floor to 2.16.4, align PAY-3/TKT-1 floors, and make dependencies schema-strict (reason only).
Repin SEC-1 to v3.3.6 and require SEC1 conformance Evidence v3 (nonce+attestation) produced by runner v1.3.1.
Hardening: mandate N-1 Ed25519 key retention window for issuer rotation; force WARN_STALE_SOVEREIGNTY to be recorded as provisional scans with sovereignty_drift_detected flag.

Hard cleanup release: metadata parity, dependency floor alignment, lawful event-consumption model, tenant-safe outbox payloads, operator accountability fields, deterministic raw-UUID conflict tie-breaks, and bundled mobile conformance companion tooling.

constraints.description: scan_outcome MUST be one of: accepted | denied.
constraints.name: scan_outcome_allowed_values

constraints.description: scan_intent MUST be one of: check_in | check_out | validate_only.
constraints.name: scan_intent_allowed_values

constraints.description: decision_authority MUST be one of: edge | online | device.
constraints.name: decision_authority_allowed_values

constraints.description: If scan_outcome == denied then reason_subcode MUST be non-null and MUST reference ERR-1.
constraints.name: denials_require_reason_subcode

constraints.description: Scan rows are append-only evidence; do not de-duplicate by (ticket_id, occurrence_id). Reconciliation may only set derived fields (superseded_by_scan_id, canonicalized_at_utc).
constraints.name: append_only_scan_evidence

constraints.description: scanned_at_corrected_utc MUST be derived deterministically from scanned_at_device_utc using the selected HydrationSession (see multiple_hydrations_allowed_append_only). For edge decision_authority, the selected HydrationSession MUST be the latest by server_time_utc for (org_id, occurrence_id, device_id) and MUST have server_time_utc + device_time_utc captured. client_clock_offset_seconds, when present, MUST equal (server_time_utc - device_time_utc) rounded to seconds.
constraints.name: scanned_at_corrected_required

constraints.description: If decision_authority == "edge" then manifest_version AND manifest_signature MUST be present on the Scan record, and MUST match the selected latest HydrationSession (same org_id, occurrence_id, device_id) with that manifest_version. Mismatch MUST fail-closed.
constraints.name: edge_decisions_require_manifest_signature

constraints.description: If decision_authority == edge then manifest_age_seconds_at_scan MUST be <= configured_max_manifest_age_seconds unless EVT-2 occurrence scan_stale_behavior permits otherwise. If manifest_age_seconds_at_scan exceeds configured_max_manifest_age_seconds, behavior MUST follow EVT-2 scan_stale_behavior: (a) deny: scan_outcome MUST be denied and reason_subcode MUST equal SCAN_MANIFEST_TOO_OLD (ERR-1); (b) warn: scan_outcome MUST be accepted, provisional MUST be false, and reason_subcode MUST equal SCAN_MANIFEST_TOO_OLD (ERR-1) as an operator notice; (c) accept_provisional: scan_outcome MUST be accepted, provisional MUST be true, and reason_subcode MUST equal SCAN_MANIFEST_TOO_OLD (ERR-1).
constraints.name: manifest_age_bounds_for_edge

constraints.description: If scan_intent == validate_only then the scan MUST NOT mutate RedemptionStatus; it is evidence-only.
constraints.name: validate_only_no_redemption

constraints.description: If scan_outcome == accepted and reason_subcode is non-null, it MUST reference ERR-1 (operator notice subcode).
constraints.name: accepted_reason_subcode_must_reference_err

constraints.description: If decision_authority == "edge" then device_boot_id and device_uptime_millis MUST be present on the Scan record, and the selected HydrationSession MUST also have device_boot_id and device_uptime_millis present. If monotonic anchors are missing, the scan MUST be denied with ERR_PRECONDITION / SCAN_DEVICE_TIME_UNTRUSTED (fail-closed) or MUST downgrade to central evaluation before allowing redemption.
constraints.name: edge_requires_monotonic_anchor_for_trusted_time

constraints.description: If decision_authority == "edge" then device_boot_id MUST match the selected HydrationSession.device_boot_id AND device_uptime_millis MUST be >= HydrationSession.device_uptime_millis. A mismatch indicates reboot/reset while offline and MUST be denied with ERR_PRECONDITION / SCAN_DEVICE_TIME_UNTRUSTED until a fresh HydrationSession is recorded.
constraints.name: edge_reboot_detection_lockout

constraints.description: If decision_authority == "edge" then the device clock MUST be validated using monotonic uptime: expected_device_time_utc_at_scan = HydrationSession.device_time_utc + (device_uptime_millis - HydrationSession.device_uptime_millis)/1000. abs(scanned_at_device_utc - expected_device_time_utc_at_scan) MUST be <= configured_max_clock_drift_seconds. If exceeded, deny with ERR_PRECONDITION / SCAN_DEVICE_TIME_UNTRUSTED.
constraints.name: edge_clock_drift_threshold_enforced

constraints.description: For decision_authority == "edge", the selected HydrationSession.server_time_utc MUST be no older than configured_max_offline_age_seconds at the time of scan evaluation. If stale, handling MUST follow EVT-2 scan_policy.stale_behavior with ERR_PRECONDITION / SCAN_STALE_DEVICE (deny | warn | accept_provisional) and MUST be recorded in the Scan record evidence.
constraints.name: offline_staleness_window_enforced

constraints.description: If the effective parent_state_fingerprint for occurrence_id (from EVT-2) does not match the fingerprint cached in the active scan manifest snapshot, the scan MUST be treated as stale sovereignty and MUST fail closed. scan_outcome MUST be denied, provisional MUST be false, and reason_subcode MUST equal WARN_STALE_SOVEREIGNTY (ERR-1) until a fresh authoritative hydration is recorded.
constraints.name: stale_sovereignty_mismatch_warn

constraints.description: For scan_intent in {check_in, check_out}, temporal validity MUST be evaluated using EntitlementSpec.valid_from_utc/valid_until_utc extended by the appropriate buffer_minutes from OFFER-1. Buffer is applied symmetrically unless EntitlementSpec defines distinct entry/exit buffers.
constraints.name: buffer_minutes_applied_to_temporal_validity

constraints.description: Every Scan evidence row MUST record operator_actor_id. operator_session_id SHOULD be recorded when an authenticated staff session exists on the device.
constraints.name: operator_accountability_required_for_scan_evidence

constraints.description: org_id on Scan MUST be derived and enforced from the authenticated device/session context on the backend. Client-supplied org_id MUST NOT widen or override tenant scope.
constraints.name: tenant_derived_from_authenticated_device_context

optional_attributes.description: Device boot/session identifier captured at scan-time for trusted-time validation. MUST be stable across offline scans until re-hydration.
optional_attributes.name: device_boot_id

optional_attributes.description: Monotonic device uptime in milliseconds captured at scan-time for trusted-time validation and reboot detection.
optional_attributes.name: device_uptime_millis

constraints.description: scan_intent MUST be one of: check_in | check_out (validate_only MUST NOT create RedemptionStatus).
constraints.name: scan_intent_allowed_values

constraints.description: redemption_state MUST be one of: unredeemed | redeemed.
constraints.name: redemption_state_allowed_values

constraints.description: Scanners MUST verify manifest_signature using SEC-1 public key identified by manifest_key_id (kid).
constraints.name: manifest_signature_verification

constraints.description: HydrationSession is append-only history. The system MUST allow multiple HydrationSession records per (org_id, occurrence_id, device_id, manifest_version). When a scan requires hydration context, the system MUST select the latest HydrationSession by server_time_utc (tie-breaker: created_at_utc then hydration_id) with the same (org_id, occurrence_id, device_id) and with manifest_version matching the scan.manifest_version (when present).

fail_closed.notes: If re-entry requires online validation per EVT-2 scan_policy and risk flags cannot be evaluated, scanner MUST fail to validate_only (not allow).

offline_hydration.notes: Hydration MAY include a bounded active-dispute set for the occurrence lifecycle. This is optional but recommended for enterprise re-entry controls.

reentry_behavior.notes: This does not revoke admission; it forces an online decision path (or guard checkpoint) when dispute risk is present.

invariants.statement: If EVT-2 parent_state_fingerprint verification fails for the occurrence at scan-time, the scan MUST fail closed, MUST record WARN_STALE_SOVEREIGNTY as the reason_subcode, and MUST be preserved for mandatory post-event audit review.

ResolutionManifest.covered_scan_ids_sha256_summary_hash MUST be computed as sha256 over the concatenation of lexicographically (memcmp) sorted 16-byte raw UUID binaries (no delimiters, no string UUID formatting).
ResolutionManifest.attest_resolution MUST fail closed if the database provisional scan count selected for resolution does not exactly equal ResolutionManifest.scan_id_count.
SignedEligibilityClaim and HydrationManifest MUST include kid (key_id). Scanners MUST NOT attempt fallback verification by trying multiple keys.

invariants.rule: A scan decision MUST NOT be accepted unless TicketCredential.status is 'active' at scan time. The scanner MUST prove it checked credential status either via an online TKT-1 lookup or via a hydrated credential revocation/supersession snapshot whose age at scan time is <= configured_max_credential_status_staleness_seconds.

notes: All hydrate_manifest operations MUST run in the DP-1 background pool to prevent API starvation during mass scanner boot.

gate_mode_forbidden_technologies: DOM-backed barcode scanning for admission truth
mobile_conformance_layer.notes: This companion tooling is a required implementation control for gate-scanner clients, but current CS-0/LINT-0 governance does not yet execute these mobile checks natively.

offline_conflict_resolution.text: When multiple Scan evidence rows for the same (org_id, occurrence_id, ticket_id, scan_intent) are later reconciled, the system MUST deterministically select exactly one winning scan to materialize RedemptionStatus truth. Default winner selection MUST be: (1) lowest scanned_at_corrected_utc wins when present and trusted; (2) if scanned_at_corrected_utc values are equal, missing, or not trustworthy, lowest device_id wins using unsigned lexicographic ordering over raw 16-byte UUID binary; (3) if device_id is also equal or unavailable, lowest scan_id wins using the same raw 16-byte UUID binary ordering. All non-winning Scan rows MUST be preserved as append-only audit evidence and MUST be marked as conflicts with an explicit reason_subcode and winner_scan_id reference. Reconciliation MUST be idempotent and MUST converge to the same winner regardless of ingestion order.

anti_patterns: SCAN-ANTI-HYDR-SCHEMA-OWNERSHIP: SCAN-1 MUST NOT define the authoritative schema of the offline hydration manifest. It MUST reference SEC-1.HYDRATION_MANIFEST.v1.

freshness_rules.text: At scan-time, scan_occurred_at_utc MUST be <= snapshot_valid_until_utc.

required_inputs.name: eligibility_issuer_keys

outbox_events.notes: Emitted when Scan evidence is recorded. MUST NOT include manifest_signature, hydration_payload_hash, geo_hash, firmware, boot_id, or uptime.
Emitted when a HydrationSession is recorded. MUST NOT include manifest_signature or hydration_payload_hash in outbox payload.
Emitted when RedemptionStatus is materialized or changes due to reconciliation. Represents admission truth for a ticket at an occurrence.

redemption_status.materialization_reason: High-scale scan queries require O(1) lookup of redemption truth without on-the-fly dispute reconciliation.

rules.statement: Scanners MUST consume ticketing.offer.key_rotated.v1 and maintain a local, versioned cache of EligibilityIssuerKey public keys for offline verification of SignedEligibilityClaim.
The scan engine MUST apply EntitlementSpec.buffer_minutes (entry/exit) from OFFER-1 when evaluating temporal validity for check_in/check_out decisions, for both online and edge decision_authority.

Scanners MUST retain the previous EligibilityIssuerKey (N-1) for a minimum rotation_window_minutes=60 after a ticketing.offer.key_rotated.v1 event, to prevent edge propagation lag from bricking recently-issued SignedEligibilityClaims or HydrationManifests.
Any scan decision that surfaces WARN_STALE_SOVEREIGNTY MUST be persisted with provisional=true and sovereignty_drift_detected=true, and MUST be discoverable for mandatory post-event audit review.

Scanners MUST select the verification key by kid (key_id) from the claim/manifest header and lookup that exact key in the local cache. If kid is missing or outside the retention window, verification MUST fail with EXT_SIGNATURE_INVALID.

An authorized auditor MAY resolve provisional scans using a single ResolutionManifest covering either an explicit scan ID list or occurrence_all_provisional. The manifest MUST be persisted before EVT-2 occurrence completion can proceed.

manifest_signing.rotation: Verification MUST accept multiple active + grace public keys (by kid) for the occurrence lifecycle.

pii.notes: Outbox events MUST NOT contain PII or cryptographic material. device_id is allowed as a restricted operational identifier and MUST be classified via DATA-1.

summary: SCAN-1 governs ticket scanning evidence, hydration authority, offline reconciliation, and admission-truth materialization. v1.6.3 is a hard cleanup release focused on internal consistency, tenant-safe event payloads, operator accountability, and deterministic reconciliation wording.

SCAN-1-VEC-BINARY-SUMMARY-001.purpose: Proves sha256 summary hashing over lexicographically sorted 16-byte UUID binaries (memcmp), concatenated without delimiters.

SCAN-1-VEC-GHOST-SCAN-COUNT-001.purpose: Prevents occurrence_all_provisional manifests from swallowing late-arriving provisional scans.
